title: Sankhpuspi Sarbat
description: Sankhpuspi Sarbat (Shankhpushpi Syrup) is another renowned Ayurvedic brain tonic made from Shankhpushpi (Convolvulus pluricaulis), a natural nervine rejuvenator. This classical formulation combats mental fatigue. Controls high anxiety. Induces sound sleep. Increases retention capacity.
dosage: 15–30 ml taken with milk or water twice a day
